text:
The bowl holds about 12 olives that look like Kalamata. Each weighs roughly 4-5 g with the pit, so the total is about 50 g.

Olives run about 115-145 kcal per 100 g, so I used roughly 1.15 kcal/g. That gives about 55-60 kcal.

The shredded carrot and onion in the side bowl are not on the plate, so I left them out.
